name: Mahou Shoujo Miracle☆Yuitto ~Dame! Onii-chan Minaide~
original_name: 魔法少女ミラクル☆ユイット ～ダメ！お兄ちゃん見ないで～
source:
Yui is a young schoolgirl with a brother complex. One day she witnesses Serina Shidou kill someone in the park. It turns out he had turned into a demon!

Serina now insists that Yui become a magical girl. If she refuses, or if she won't fight demons Serina will simply murder her.

So Yui becomes Magical Girl Miracle Yuiito and fights demons while Serina's heart softens toward her new friend and humans in general. But how will they fight back when the enemy knows who they are?
translation:
冰室ユイ是一名有恋兄情结的年幼女学生。某天，她在公园目睹祠堂芹那杀死一个人——原来，对方已经变成了恶魔！

芹那强迫ユイ成为魔法少女。如果她拒绝，或不愿与恶魔战斗，芹那就会直接杀了她。

于是，ユイ化身“魔法少女Miracle☆Yuitto”与恶魔作战。芹那面对新朋友时，冷酷的心也渐渐变得柔软，开始对人类改观。然而，当敌人识破她们的身份，两人又该如何反击？
